topic: ROUND THREE of this lane: five bounded iterations on angles the first two rounds (glm-5-3-flash-ripgrep-search, deepseek-v4-flash-ripgrep-search) covered thinly or not at all, on system-spec-kit's lexical retrieval after the memory-database decommission. Every confirmed row of rounds one and two was remediated in 006-retrieval-drift-remediation and 013-trigger-phrase-quality-enforcement; the census research/confirmed-findings.md judged every row of both rounds.

charter.role: Skeptical auditor - every claim unverified until cited
charter.target: a cited defect-and-simplification ledger organized by angle, not a narrative
charter.hardLimits: max 12 tool calls per iteration; no scripts/harnesses/census programs; read files and compare by hand; sample at most 8 items per set; never run validate.sh, node tooling, or git (compiled dist dirs untracked and stale); read the checked-in source; code overrides self-reported success; do not re-report a census row marked fixed/kept/recorded unless its stated reason is contradicted by new evidence; never reuse an earlier count
charter.stopConditions: exactly 5 iterations, one angle each, in the given order; no early convergence; convergenceThreshold=3 is telemetry only

reducer.note: inline dispatched lineage: this process IS the executor for every iteration (no nested CLI/agent dispatch). Reducer-owned artifacts (findings-registry.json, deep-research-dashboard.md) are left to the fanout runner; the executor writes iteration markdown, deltas, state records, and the terminal synthesis into the lineage dir only, mirroring the prior rounds' record schemas.
